v1_3_0.label: v1.3.0
v1_3_0.summary: The v1.3.0 release is planned around article sharing. This update focuses on making summarized content easy to share, view publicly, and engage with.

item1.title: Public share links for articles
item1.description: Generate and manage public links for summarized articles directly from the product.

item2.title: Dedicated shared article experience
item2.description: Shared pages are optimized for readability with clear metadata and original source context.

item3.title: Discussion and empathy interactions
item3.description: Readers can react and participate through comments, replies, and empathy actions.

item4.title: Advanced sharing controls
item4.description: Support custom share URL and thumbnail options for cleaner distribution.

v1_2_0.label: v1.2.0
v1_2_0.summary: Latest extension release in the published sequence. This release follows extension-v1.1.0 and represents the current stable extension baseline.

item1.title: Extension release progression
item1.description: Published as part of the extension-v1.0.0 → v1.1.0 → v1.2.0 sequence.

item2.title: Traceable release comparison
item2.description: GitHub compare links provide transparent change tracking between extension versions.

item3.title: Stable extension baseline
item3.description: Serves as the latest stable extension tag before the next planned milestone.

item4.title: Release metadata alignment
item4.description: Version naming and publish timing are aligned with GitHub release records.

v1_1_0.label: v1.1.0
v1_1_0.summary: Incremental extension release preceding v1.2.0, used as the comparison base for the latest extension update.

item1.title: Intermediate extension milestone
item1.description: Acts as the stepping stone between extension-v1.0.0 and extension-v1.2.0.

item2.title: Version continuity
item2.description: Maintains release continuity and semantic upgrade flow for extension users.

item3.title: Comparable release boundary
item3.description: Provides a clear boundary for comparing changes into extension-v1.2.0.

item4.title: Published release trace
item4.description: Recorded in GitHub releases to keep extension history auditable.

v1_0_0.label: v1.0.0
v1_0_0.summary: First production baseline of NOD web, with extension v1.0.0 released later the same day as the initial extension line start.

item1.title: Production web baseline
item1.description: Shipped dashboard, article list/detail, and AI summary workflow for web.

item2.title: Search and export capabilities
item2.description: Included semantic search, markdown export, and localized UI support.

item3.title: Billing integration
item3.description: Integrated pricing and billing management flow in the web product.

item4.title: Extension line kickoff
item4.description: extension-v1.0.0 established the first extension release track.

privacy.intro: NOD (the "Service") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information in compliance with applicable laws, including the Korean Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and how you can exercise your rights.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose of Processing Personal Information
purpose.content:
We process personal information for the following purposes:

(a) Member management: User identification, login authentication, session management, and account administration.
(b) Core service delivery: Article saving, AI-powered summarization, key point extraction, concept tagging, content classification, semantic search, and embedding generation.
(c) Subscription and payment management: Subscription status management, payment processing via Paddle, billing history, and promotional code administration.
(d) Service improvement: Service quality enhancement, error analysis and diagnosis, usage statistics, security monitoring, and fraud prevention.
(e) Communication: Service notices, policy change notifications, and responses to user inquiries.
(f) Legal compliance: Fulfillment of obligations under applicable laws and regulations.

collection.title: 2. Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods
collection.content:
We collect the following categories of personal information. Items marked as required are necessary for service provision; optional items may be declined without affecting core functionality.

Required information (Account):
- Email address, name, profile image (as provided by your social login provider), password hash (for email registration), authentication tokens.

Required information (Service):
- Article URLs, titles, extracted body text, and related metadata saved through the web application or Chrome extension.

Automatically generated information:
- AI-generated summaries, key points, concept tags, content classifications, and embedding vectors produced by processing your saved content.

Service usage information:
- Usage records (e.g., save counts, AI analysis counts), subscription information, promotional code redemption records.

Social activity information (optional):
- Shared links, comments, likes, and display names created through the social features of the Service.

Device and access information:
- IP address, User-Agent string, browser type, Chrome extension version, access timestamps.

OAuth information:
- Social login provider (Google, GitHub, Facebook, Kakao) identifiers, email addresses, names, and profile images as authorized by you during the OAuth flow.

Analytics information:
- Website usage data collected through Google Analytics (e.g., page views, events, session duration).

Collection methods: Direct input during registration; automatic collection through the web application, Chrome extension, cookies, and analytics tools; information received from third-party OAuth providers upon your authorization.
collection.note: When using the Chrome extension, the URL and body text of web pages you choose to save are extracted and transmitted to the Service. The extension operates only upon your explicit action and does not collect browsing data in the background.

retention.title: 3. Retention Periods
retention.content:
We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law. When the retention period expires, personal information is promptly destroyed.

Service usage period:
- Account information, saved content, and AI-generated data are retained while your account remains active. Upon account deletion, data is destroyed within 30 days, except as required by law.

Statutory retention periods (Korean law):
- Records of contracts and withdrawal of offers (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce): 5 years
- Records of payment and supply of goods/services: 5 years
- Records of consumer complaints and dispute resolution: 3 years
- Login and access logs (Protection of Communications Secrets Act): 3 months

Backup retention:
- Production database backups are retained for 30 days and development backups for 7 days, after which they are automatically purged.

thirdParty.title: 4. Disclosure to Third Parties
thirdParty.content:
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may disclose personal information to third parties only in the following circumstances:

(a) With your explicit consent.
(b) Where required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process.
(c) To protect the rights, property, or safety of the Company, our users, or the public.
(d) In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, with notice to affected users.

delegation.title: 5. Delegation of Processing
delegation.content:
We use the following trusted service providers to operate and improve the Service. These providers process personal information only within the scope of their delegated tasks and under contractual data protection obligations.

- AI processing (Google Gemini, OpenAI): Article summarization, key point extraction, concept tagging, embedding generation.
- Payment processing (Paddle): Subscription management, payment processing, tax collection, refund processing.
- Cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud Platform): Service hosting, data storage, and computational processing.
- Authentication (Supabase): User authentication, session management, OAuth integration.
- AI observability (Langfuse): AI call logging and performance monitoring.
- Error tracking (Sentry): Error reporting, diagnostic data collection.
- Analytics (Google Analytics): Website usage statistics and user behavior analysis.

internationalTransfer.title: 6. International Transfer of Personal Information
internationalTransfer.content:
To provide the Service, your personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence. We implement appropriate safeguards for all international transfers in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

The following transfers are currently in effect:

- Google (Gemini API) | United States | AI summarization and analysis | Article content, titles, URLs | Retained for up to 55 days for abuse monitoring (paid API; not used for model training)
- OpenAI | United States | AI summarization and analysis (alternative provider) | Article content, titles, URLs | Retained for up to 30 days
- Paddle | United Kingdom / United States | Payment processing | Email, payment information | Retained per Paddle's privacy policy
- Supabase | United States | User authentication | Email, OAuth tokens | Retained while account is active
- Langfuse | Germany (EU) | AI observability | AI call logs (may include prompt/response data) | Retained per retention settings
- Sentry | United States | Error tracking | Error logs, user identifiers | Retained per Sentry's data retention policy

For transfers from the EU/EEA, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or applicable adequacy decisions. For transfers from Korea, we comply with PIPA requirements for cross-border data transfers, including obtaining consent where required.

destruction.title: 7. Destruction Procedures and Methods
destruction.content:
When personal information is no longer needed for its intended purpose or the retention period has expired, it is promptly destroyed according to the following procedures:

Procedure: The information subject to destruction is identified, approved by the person responsible for personal information protection, and then destroyed.

Methods:
- Electronic files: Permanently deleted using methods that prevent recovery (e.g., cascading database deletion, secure file erasure).
- Physical documents: Shredded or incinerated.
- Backup data: Automatically purged upon expiration of the backup retention period (production: 30 days; development: 7 days).

rights.title: 8. Data Subject Rights and How to Exercise Them
rights.content:
You have the following rights regarding your personal information, which you may exercise at any time:

(a) Right of access: Request access to your personal information and details of its processing.
(b) Right to correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
(c) Right to deletion: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention requirements.
(d) Right to suspend processing: Request that we suspend the processing of your personal information.
(e) Right to data portability: Request a copy of your personal information in a structured, commonly used format (where technically feasible).
(f) Right to object: Object to the processing of your personal information, including for automated decision-making.

How to exercise your rights: Send a request to shickcoong777@gmail.com specifying which right you wish to exercise. We will verify your identity and process your request within 10 days. If we cannot comply with your request, we will notify you of the reason within the same period.

You may exercise these rights directly or through a legally authorized representative. If you use a representative, a power of attorney must be submitted.

automatedDecisions.title: 9. Automated Decision-Making
automatedDecisions.content:
The Service uses AI technology to perform automated processing of your saved content. In accordance with Article 37-2 of the Korean Personal Information Protection Act, we disclose the following:

Types of automated decisions:
- Content type classification (e.g., news article, technical blog, academic paper)
- AI-generated summarization and key point extraction
- Automatic concept extraction and tagging
- Similarity-based article recommendations via vector embeddings (cosine similarity)

Key personal information used: Article titles, body text, URLs, and content metadata.

These automated processes are designed to assist your knowledge management and do not produce decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on you. All AI-generated results are provided for reference purposes only.

Your rights: You may request an explanation of how automated decisions were made and may object to such processing. To do so, contact us at shickcoong777@gmail.com.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies to operate and improve the Service.

Types of cookies used:
- Essential cookies: Required for authentication, session management, and security. These cannot be disabled without losing core functionality.
- Preference cookies: Store your language, theme, and display settings.
- Analytics cookies: Collect usage statistics through Google Analytics to help us understand how the Service is used and improve it accordingly.

Cookie management: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling essential cookies may prevent you from using the Service. For users in the EU/EEA, non-essential cookies are only set with your prior consent.

Do Not Track: We currently do not respond to Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals, as there is no universally accepted standard for DNT compliance.

behavioralInfo.title: 11. Behavioral Information Collection (Chrome Extension)
behavioralInfo.content:
The NOD Chrome extension collects certain behavioral information to provide its core functionality.

Information collected:
- URLs and body text of web pages you explicitly choose to save
- Page metadata (title, author, publication date) of saved pages
- Extension usage events (e.g., save button clicks)

Purpose: To enable article saving, AI analysis, and content management within the Service.

Information NOT collected:
- General browsing history or activity on pages you do not save
- Data from other browser tabs or windows
- Keystrokes, form inputs, or credentials on any website

The extension operates in compliance with Chrome Web Store policies, including the Limited Use Policy. Data collected through the extension is used solely for user-facing features of the Service and is never used for advertising, sold to data brokers, or transferred to third parties for purposes unrelated to the Service.

security.title: 12. Security Measures
security.content:
We implement the following technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information:

Technical measures:
- Password encryption using bcrypt one-way hashing
- Authentication token encryption using JWE (A256KW + A256GCM)
- All data transmitted over HTTPS (TLS encryption in transit)
- Database access restricted via private VPC with no external access
- Secrets managed through Google Secret Manager
- Automated backups with point-in-time recovery

Organizational measures:
- Access to personal information restricted to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis
- Internal data handling procedures and guidelines
- Regular review of security practices

officer.title: 13. Data Protection Officer
officer.content:
For any inquiries, complaints, or requests related to the processing of your personal information, please contact:

Data Protection Contact:
- Service: NOD
- Email: shickcoong777@gmail.com

The Data Protection Contact will respond to your inquiries and process your data subject rights requests.

changes.title: 14. Changes to This Policy
changes.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or Service features.

Notification procedures:
- For general changes: We will post the updated policy on the Service and announce the changes at least 7 days before the effective date.
- For significant changes that materially affect your rights (e.g., changes to the categories of information collected, purposes of processing, or third-party disclosures): We will provide at least 30 days' prior notice through in-service announcements and, where feasible, individual notification (e.g., email).

The revised policy takes effect on its stated effective date. Your continued use of the Service after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

remedies.title: 15. Remedies for Rights Violations
remedies.content:
If you believe your personal information rights have been violated, you may seek assistance from the following organizations:

Korean agencies:
- Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: (02) 2100-2499 | https://www.kopico.go.kr
- Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA) Privacy Center: 118 | https://privacy.kisa.or.kr
- Supreme Prosecutors' Office Cyber Investigation Division: (02) 3480-3573
- Korean National Police Agency Cyber Bureau: 182 | https://ecrm.cyber.go.kr

For EU/EEA users (GDPR):
You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority. You also have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and to object to processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at shickcoong777@gmail.com.

For California users (CCPA/CPRA):
You have the right to know what personal information we collect and how it is used, the right to request deletion, and the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. We do not sell your personal information. To exercise your rights, contact us at shickcoong777@gmail.com. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your CCPA rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

refund.intro: This Refund and Cancellation Policy applies to NOD's paid subscription plan (Pro). All payments are processed through Paddle.com, which acts as the Merchant of Record. This policy complies with the Korean Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, the EU Consumer Rights Directive, and the Content User Protection Guidelines.

cancellation.title: 1. Subscription Cancellation
cancellation.content:
You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings or by contacting us at shickcoong777@gmail.com. Upon cancellation:

(a) You will retain access to Pro features until the end of your current billing period.
(b) No further charges will be made after the current billing period ends.
(c) Your account will automatically revert to the Free plan at the end of the billing period.
(d) Your saved content and data will be preserved and remain accessible under the Free plan.

withdrawal.title: 2. Right of Withdrawal
withdrawal.content:
You have the right to withdraw from your subscription and receive a full refund, without providing any reason, within the following periods:

Korean users: Within 7 days of the initial purchase date or the most recent auto-renewal date, in accordance with Article 17 of the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.

EU/UK users: Within 14 days of the initial purchase date or the most recent auto-renewal date, in accordance with the EU Consumer Rights Directive.

All other users: Within 7 days of the initial purchase date or the most recent auto-renewal date.

To exercise your right of withdrawal, contact us at shickcoong777@gmail.com with your account email and a statement that you wish to withdraw. No specific form is required.

Note: As the Service is a "divisible service" (ongoing subscription), even after the withdrawal period has expired, you may still be eligible for a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of your subscription (see Section 3).

proRata.title: 3. Pro-Rata Refund After Withdrawal Period
proRata.content:
If the withdrawal period specified in Section 2 has expired, you may still request cancellation and receive a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of your current billing period.

The refund amount is calculated using the following formula:

Refund = Payment Amount - (Payment Amount / Total Days in Billing Period x Days Used)

Example: If you paid $5 for a monthly subscription and request cancellation after 10 days of a 30-day billing period:
Refund = $5 - ($5 / 30 x 10) = $3.33

For annual subscriptions, the used portion may be calculated at the standard monthly rate ($5/month) multiplied by the number of full months used, with the remainder refunded.

Pro-rata refunds are available upon request and are not automatic.

autoRenewal.title: 4. Auto-Renewal Refund
autoRenewal.content:
NOD subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period. We will take the following measures regarding auto-renewal:

(a) Pre-renewal notice: We will send you a notification at least 7 days before each auto-renewal date, informing you of the renewal date, amount to be charged, and payment method.
(b) Price increase consent: If the subscription price increases, we will obtain your explicit consent at least 30 days before the new price takes effect. If you do not consent, your subscription will not renew at the new price.
(c) Cancellation method disclosure: Each renewal notice will include clear instructions on how to cancel.

Refund for auto-renewal charges:
- If we fail to send the pre-renewal notice, you are entitled to a full refund of the renewal charge.
- If we sent proper notice, you may still request a refund within 7 days (Korean users) or 14 days (EU/UK users) of the renewal date.
- After the applicable withdrawal period, a pro-rata refund as described in Section 3 is available.

serviceDisruption.title: 5. Compensation for Service Disruptions
serviceDisruption.content:
If the Service becomes unavailable due to reasons attributable to the Company, the following compensation applies to paid subscribers, in accordance with the Content User Protection Guidelines:

(a) Disruption of 10 hours or less per month: The subscription period will be extended by the duration of the disruption at no additional charge.
(b) Disruption exceeding 10 hours per month: The subscription period will be extended by 10 hours plus twice the excess hours beyond 10 hours.
(c) Disruption exceeding 72 hours per month: You may terminate the subscription and receive a full refund for the remaining subscription period, plus compensation for any damages incurred.

This section does not apply to service interruptions caused by scheduled maintenance (with at least 24 hours' advance notice), force majeure events, or circumstances attributable to the user.

process.title: 6. Refund Processing
process.content:
Once a refund is approved, we will initiate the refund process within 3 business days.

Refund method: Refunds are processed to your original payment method through Paddle. For credit/debit card payments, we will promptly request the payment processor to cancel or reverse the charge.

Processing time: While we initiate refunds within 3 business days, the actual time for the refund to appear in your account depends on your payment provider and may take additional time.

Late refund penalty: If we fail to process a refund within the legally required period, we will pay delayed interest at an annual rate of 15% in accordance with the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.

How to request a refund: Send your request to shickcoong777@gmail.com with your account email address and the reason for your refund request. You may also contact Paddle's customer support directly.

dispute.title: 7. Dispute Resolution
dispute.content:
If you are dissatisfied with our handling of a refund request, you may pursue resolution through the following channels:

Step 1 - Direct resolution: Contact us at shickcoong777@gmail.com. We will respond within 3 business days and endeavor to resolve the matter promptly.

Step 2 - Consumer counseling: Contact the Korea Consumer Counseling Center at 1372 or your local consumer protection agency.

Step 3 - Korea Consumer Agency: File a complaint for damage relief with the Korea Consumer Agency at https://www.consumer.go.kr.

Step 4 - Consumer Dispute Mediation Committee: If no agreement is reached, request mediation from the Consumer Dispute Mediation Committee. An accepted mediation decision has the same effect as a court settlement.

EU/UK users may also contact their local consumer protection authority or use the EU Online Dispute Resolution platform at https://ec.europa.eu/odr.

definitions.title: 2. Definitions
definitions.content:

(a) "Service" means the NOD web application, Chrome extension, mobile application, and all related features, tools, and APIs provided by the Company.
(b) "User" means any individual who accesses or uses the Service, including both registered members and visitors.

serviceDescription.title: 4. Service Description and Changes
serviceDescription.content:
The Company provides an AI-powered knowledge management service with the following features:

(a) Article saving from web pages via the Chrome extension or web application
(b) AI-generated summarization, key point extraction, and content classification
(c) Automatic concept extraction and tagging
(d) Semantic search across saved articles using vector embeddings
(e) Social features including article sharing, comments, and reactions
(f) Chrome extension for one-click saving and analysis

Service changes:
- The Company may modify, add, or discontinue features of the Service. For changes that materially affect Users, the Company will provide at least 30 days' advance notice.
- Service may be temporarily interrupted for the following reasons: scheduled maintenance (with advance notice), emergency server maintenance, network or equipment failures, or force majeure events.

serviceTiers.content:

Free plan:
- AI analysis: Up to 20 analyses per month
- Article saving and AI-powered analysis
- Semantic search: Unlimited
- Concept extraction and markdown export

Pro plan ($5/month, inclusive of applicable taxes):

Usage limits reset on the first day of each calendar month. The Company reserves the right to modify plan features and pricing with at least 30 days' advance notice. Existing subscribers will continue under their current terms until their next renewal date.

chromeExtension.title: 11. Chrome Extension Terms
chromeExtension.content:
The NOD Chrome extension is subject to the following additional terms:

(a) Permissions: The extension requires certain browser permissions (activeTab, storage, scripting) to provide its core functionality. The extension accesses web page content only when you explicitly initiate a save action.
(b) Data access: When you use the extension to save an article, the extension accesses the current page's URL, body text, and metadata (title, author, publication date). This data is transmitted to the Service for processing and storage.
(c) Limited Use Policy: The extension complies with the Chrome Web Store Limited Use Policy. Data collected through the extension is used exclusively for user-facing features of the Service and is not used for advertising, sold to data brokers, or transferred to third parties for purposes unrelated to the Service.
(d) No background collection: The extension does not monitor or collect data from your browsing activity. It operates only in response to your explicit actions.
(e) Updates: The extension may be updated from time to time. Significant changes to data collection or permissions will be communicated through the Service or Chrome Web Store update notes.

aiServices.content:
The Service uses artificial intelligence technology to process and analyze your saved Articles. In accordance with the Korean Framework Act on Artificial Intelligence, we disclose the following:

(a) AI disclosure: The Service utilizes AI models provided by third parties (including Google Gemini and OpenAI) to generate summaries, extract key points, classify content, generate concept tags, and create embedding vectors.

(c) Data transfer: To perform AI analysis, Article titles, body text, and related metadata may be transmitted to AI service providers (Google, OpenAI) located in the United States. This data is processed solely for the purpose of generating analysis results and is subject to our Privacy Policy.
(d) Copyright limitations: Under Korean copyright law, content generated solely by AI may not qualify for copyright protection. The Company does not assert copyright over AI Analysis Results.
(e) No model training: Your data is not used for training AI models. When using paid API tiers, AI providers do not use your data for model improvement.
(f) Similar outputs: Due to the nature of AI processing, similar Articles may produce similar AI Analysis Results for different Users.
(g) AI-generated content labeling: AI Analysis Results are labeled as AI-generated within the Service, in compliance with applicable AI transparency requirements.
